routes.name: Residencia Permanente para Residentes Temporales por 5 años o más

note: Guatemala, read on the Guatemalan Migration Institute's own pages (extranjeria.igm.gob.gt) and its official 2026 tariff on 2026-10-30, the fees as set by the reformed fee rules (Acuerdo IGM-039-2025), in US dollars. Foreign artists contracted by a person or company in Guatemala take the temporary residence for artists, applied for in Guatemala (it asks the last entry stamp and a certificate of the last entry), with the contracting party's job offer and a Guatemalan guarantor (read as work for the sponsor). Temporary residence is granted for 1 to 5 years by category; the 1-year grant is kept, its cost $25 to file plus $200 for the status ($300 for 2 years, $500 for 3 to 5), so $225; it can be extended (prórroga, $25 to file). Permanent residence for those who have held temporary residence for at least 5 continuous years costs $25 plus $700 ($725, with a $40 annual fee the form doesn't hold; Central Americans $500 after 1 year). Naturalisation may be asked after 5 continuous years as a permanent resident, so only the permanent route's years are said to count.
